chunks: And it is narrated from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿAmr, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “I purchase one hundred containers of oil, and I inspect one or two containers and weigh them, then I take the remainder according to that measure.”
So he said: “There is no harm.”

key_terms.أَتَّزِنُهُمَا: I weigh the two of them; using weight to determine quantity
key_terms.أَشْتَرِي: I purchase; the act of buying in a sale transaction
key_terms.رَاوِيَةً: a container or vessel used here for measured quantities of oil
key_terms.سَائِرَهُ: the rest of it; the remainder of the purchased goods
key_terms.عَلَى قَدْرِ ذَلِكَ: according to that measure; based on the quantity established from the sample
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; an expression of permissibility

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible in Islamic law to estimate a bulk oil purchase by weighing only one or two containers?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling permitting a buyer to estimate the rest of a bulk purchase by weighing one or two representative containers. It indicates permissibility in this commercial practice when the remaining goods are taken according to that established measure.
